novelty: One (root, preverb) key space over three previously separate upasarga datasets — the DCS workbook decomposition, the Gita root x preverb semantics and the per-class verb-form frequencies — so a prefix reading can be cited across corpus, text and paradigm instead of being re-derived per question. The H4477 census anchor (34 shared nonempty-preverb keys) is reproduced exactly, which is what makes the join auditable.
